title: THE FORGE: ELEMENT EFFECTS AND SOUNDS
why: His idea of 2026-10-12: upgrade guns and add elemental damage. Each element now looks and sounds like itself, on the body that was hit and never as a screen tint: FIRE puts flames and embers on the body (and smoke behind a panicking pillager), SHOCK draws a jagged arc to the second enemy and small arcs over a stunned machine, CRYO puts frost on a chilled body and an ice block round a frozen one, ACID drips green. Element tracers are wider and in the element colour, each element has its own impact sound and a freeze cracks. A forged gun glows at your hands, gold for MK II and the element colour for MK III. In co-op the host sends the statuses, the arcs and each player forged gun, so both windows see the same thing.
now: Elemental hits now show flames, arcs, frost, ice and acid, and a forged gun glows.
